sentences.text:
Anesur Rahaman @ Ansur Sk. & Anr vs Unknown on 19 June,
2023
19.06.2023 C.R.M. (A) 2086 of 2023
 Sl. 151
Court No. 29
 Sourav
 In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 (Allowed) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Suti Police
 Station Case No. 227 of 2023 dated 02.05.2023 under Sections
 498A/325/326/307/34 Ipc.

And
 In the matter of: Anesur Rahaman @ Ansur Sk. & Anr.
 ....petitioners.
 Mr. Tapodip Gupta
 ...for the petitioners.
 Mr. Bidyur Kumar Roy
 Ms. Rita Datta
 ...for the State.

1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioners are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of the deceased.
3. The deceased is stated to have jumped from the roof of a mosque.
4. The investigation has been taken up on the basis of the offence under Section 306 IPC and other allied offences thereof.
There is, however, omnibus allegation against the petitioners so far as harassment and torture in connection with demand of dowry is concerned.

5. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioners, nature of allegation and substantial progress in the investigation, it is directed that each of the petitioners shall be released on bail in the event of their arrest by the Arresting Officer on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case in connection with G.R. Case arising out of Suti Police Station Case No. 227 of 2023 dated 02.05.2023 including the conditions that i) the petitioner no. 1 shall appear before the I.O. for the purpose of investigation once in a fortnight on the day and time fixed by the I.O.; ia) the petitioner no. 2 shall appear before the I.O. for the purpose of investigation as and when required; ii) the petitioners shall not threaten, induce or coerce any witness of this case in any manner whatsoever during the currency of this order.
6. Within 21 days of the receipt of server copy or certified copy of this order, the petitioner is directed to appear before the I.O along with a copy of this order.
